**Johnson & Johnson** had the higher net margin in fiscal 2025, by roughly 10 percentage points. This is an estimate from figures I recalled rather than looked up, so treat the Pfizer numbers in particular as approximate.

- **Johnson & Johnson:** net earnings of about $26.8B on sales of about $94.2B, which is a net margin of about 28.4%.
- **Pfizer:** net income of about $11.3B on revenue of about $62.6B, which is a net margin of about 18%.

The gap is about 28.4% − 18.1% ≈ 10.3 percentage points.
